title: hieracium laevigatum subsp. knafii
intro: Hieracium laevigatum subsp. knafii, commonly known as the yellow hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion family that is native to the Iberian Peninsula. The yellow hawkweed has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including its purported anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of soothing skin irritations and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium laevigatum subsp. knafii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using yellow hawkweed for medicinal purposes.
